content: ...You'll report to Harry St. John, our VP of Revenue for the US, and be one of the senior voices for Legora with federal buyers, from agency general counsel offices to CIO, CISO and contracting leadership. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Own the federal number: pipeline, forecast, bookings and the multi-year revenue plan. - Decide where we play first. Prioritize agencies based on legal use cases, customer access, procurement paths, security authorization readiness and commercial potential. - Personally lead and close our first federal deals, drawing on your existing agency relationships. - Hire, onboard and coach the first account executives and supporting roles, and set the bar for the team. - Turn early wins into a repeatable motion: how we qualify, which buying path we pursue for each opportunity, how security reviews are sequenced, and how we plan around agency budget cycles. - Coordinate with Security, Compliance, Legal and Finance to understand agency requirements, align deal timelines with authorization and contracting milestones, and surface blockers early. - Partner with Legal Engineering and Solutions Consulting to run evaluations, pilots and proofs of value that agency lawyers actually adopt. - Shape our approach to resellers, integrators and contract-vehicle holders. - Carry the voice of federal customers back to Product and company leadership. - Build Legora's presence in the Washington legal and gov-tech community. - Travel to agency sites, New York City and other Legora locations as the work requires. WHAT YOU BRING - 8+ years in enterprise technology sales, with a substantial portion selling directly to U.S. federal agencies. - A record of exceeding a federal sales quota yourself, alongside experience hiring, coaching and managing federal sellers and building or scaling a federal sales team. - Existing relationships across federal legal, CIO, CISO and procurement offices that can open doors for a new vendor. - Working knowledge of how the federal government buys: FAR basics, schedules and contract vehicles, other-transaction and sole-source routes, and selling through resellers and primes. - Experience selling enterprise software through federal security and auth

Enterprise means depth: larger, more complex accounts with more revenue at stake. Each account is a global legal function with multiple teams, jurisdictions and business units, its own governance, and a long, multi-phase roadmap. Success depends on navigating that complexity: aligning General Counsel, legal operations, IT, security and procurement, and building momentum one team and one use case at a time until Legora is used across the whole function. At the heart of the role is designing each client's enterprise adoption strategy and delivering the change programmes that transform how they work. For every account you will build a tailored, multi-year roadmap, sequence initiatives from the first pilot teams to function-wide and global adoption, define measurable outcomes and ROI with executive sponsors, and evolve the programme as new AI capabilities and use cases emerge. You will be critical as we continue to build a best-in-class enterprise adoption programme at Legora, helping clients realise measurable ROI, expand successful use cases and transform the way their teams work. WHAT YOU'LL DO You'll lead the post-sale customer experience, owning onboarding, adoption and long-term value realisation for a portfolio of enterprise accounts. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. Getting that right is one of the most critical and complex challenges at Legora. Every jurisdiction holds billions of pages of critical legal text scattered across hundreds of sources: statutes, case law, regulatory guidance, secondary materials, and more. Only about 3% is publicly accessible on the web. The rest is buried across courts, agencies, and archives. Getting this right doesn't just improve a product feature. It shapes how lawyers around the world navigate legal information for the next several decades. As a Legal Data Analyst at Legora, you will own this challenge. You will be responsible for mapping the legal source ecosystem, deciding and prioritising what we go after, and determining how this content is structured and systematised. You will be the one who makes sure we actually get legal data right. Few roles at the company have more direct impact on Legora AI's ability to navigate the law correctly.
